items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Nothing flashy. And one day, they showed me playing -- they flashed it on the screen. Abner Jones' protege.

ctx.x: And so Abner said, 'I see you all the time in here.' He said, 'You just watch all the time. Can you play drums?' I said, 'A little bit.' He said, 'You want to sit in and play?' And when he said that, I got nervous. I said 'Yes,' and so he knew I was --
